description: A hot market is a high-value local business type, such as dentists, law firms, roofers or restaurants, in one of the largest US cities (or Santa Monica and Venice, CA), with at least 5 websites on sale; they are ordered by how many websites are on sale, not by any measure of competition. Each with its business type, city, state, its part of the US (region_group: west, south, midwest or northeast), how many websites are on sale in it, and the search_website_gaps arguments that list them.
name: list_hot_markets
title: Hot markets
